title: Gas Bundle Reduction for Residential Electricity Supply Plan Changes
content:
**Rule.** When a Beacon Ridge gas agreement under Residential Natural Gas Supply on the same premise as the Residential Electricity Supply agreement is active on a fixed-rate gas plan, the fixed-bundle plan reduction of 0.30 cents per kWh applies to the plan-change rate; when it is active on a gas plan that is not fixed-rate, the other-bundle plan reduction of 0.20 cents per kWh applies; when no gas agreement on the premise is active, none applies.

| Gas agreement at the premise | Gas plan | Plan bundle reduction (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|---|
| active | fixed-rate | 0.30 |
| active | not fixed-rate | 0.20 |
| enrollment pending, drop pending or closed | any | none |
| none | not applicable | none |

**Records read.** The status of the gas agreement recorded at the same premise and the rate type of its gas plan.
